values.subject: Re: Confirming the scope of onboarding health information
values.body_text: We have paused the request for clinic records, medication history, and physician contacts. Please first provide a limited-purpose fitness-for-duty conclusion and confirm that only the Hanyu Health onboarding team may receive it for this role assessment. The retention period and deletion arrangements still await legal confirmation. Before your written consent, Anheng Consulting is not authorized to receive the conclusion.
